name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines (1979–1985)
description: Three vertical stripes of dark blue, yellow and green separated by narrow white stripes, with the coat of arms on a green breadfruit leaf in the centre of the yellow stripe.
history: Flag designed by Elaine Liverpool and adopted when Saint Vincent became independent on 27 October 1979: the blue, yellow and green of the present flag, with white fimbriations and the arms on a breadfruit leaf. The fimbriations were removed in March 1985 and the flag with the three green diamonds was adopted on 12 October 1985.
